decisive_items: a 5 × 5 cm swelling of the left labia majora without signs of inflammation
a clinical diagnosis of Bartholin’s abscess was made
response.rationale: After antibiotics, inflammation resolved but a firm, non-cystic labial mass persisted, which contradicts a Bartholin abscess and is most consistent with a solid vulvar neoplasm among the supplied choices.

rejected.why: Bartholin abscess is contradicted by the firm non-cystic character of the mass and resolution of inflammation, rather than a fluctuant infected cyst.
